title: Reference Plan
description: Reference selection for one page and one provider (production/issues/<ISS_ID>/pages/<PG_ID>/reference-plan.yaml). One role per entry, and an asset appears once; a style entry is never also identity.

provider.description: Provider the plan is budgeted for.

budget.description: The provider's reference image limit at planning time.

mode.description: The page's generation.mode the plan was built for. A plan whose mode, provider, or budget no longer matches the page is rebuilt before compiling. Absent in older plans, which count as full_page.

required.description: Images the request must carry, in priority order.

optional.description: Images added when the budget allows.

exclude.description: Asset IDs deliberately left out, with the reason in notes.

notes.description: Free-form notes for people. Never read by scripts.

entry.description: One reference image with exactly one role.

asset_id.description: Asset ID, or a render ID when a previous page is attached.

entity.description: Entity the asset belongs to; null for a render.

role.description: The single role this image plays in the request.

priority.description: What to keep when the provider budget is short.

reason.description: Why the page needs this image.

omission_risk.description: What goes wrong if it is left out.
